description: Golden evaluation set for the UrbanPulse RAG assistant. Each question carries expected labels (topics / sentiment / locations) used as a relevance proxy: a retrieved post counts as relevant when it matches every specified expectation. Topics refer to the post's primary topic; 'locations' must use exact analytics_district names.
